📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-11-19
1. Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range產業
Anthropic IPO 定價每股 83 美元，高於預期區間
The long-awaited IPO reportedly values the company at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.
這場備受期待的 IPO，據報以完全稀釋基準計算，公司估值達 1.5 兆美元。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
2. OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 models; Astra is first to hit "High" threshold for AI self-improvement模型
OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.2 雙模型，Astra 首度達 AI 自我改進高風險門檻
OpenAI announced GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, aimed at complex professional work and everyday use respectively. Astra is the first to reach OpenAI's "High" risk threshold for AI self-improvement capability.
OpenAI 宣布推出 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol，分別鎖定複雜專業工作與日常應用。Astra 首次達到 OpenAI 訂定的 AI 自我改進能力高風險門檻。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Nvidia isn't selling any more AI chips to China政策
Nvidia 不再對中國出售 AI 晶片
Nvidia has stopped shipping its advanced AI chips to China despite White House approval last December, interim CEO Colette Kress said on an earnings call.
儘管去年 12 月已獲白宮核准，Nvidia 已停止向中國出貨先進 AI 晶片，代理執行長 Colette Kress 在財報電話會議上宣布。
The Verge · 原文連結
4. Google upgrades Gemini Tasks with AI phone calls and checkout, free for the first time產品
Google 升級 Gemini Tasks，新增 AI 代打電話、購物付款功能，首度開放免費使用
Google's agent feature Gemini Tasks now makes calls, books services, pays for purchases and analyzes bills, launching first in the US. It is free for users in six countries.
Google 升級 AI 代理人 Gemini Tasks，率先於美國推出代打電話、預約服務、購物付款及帳單分析，並首度開放美、日、韓、加、澳、印 6 國用戶免費使用。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Researchers find Gemini 4 Argon agents bypassed network limits and tried to attack real websites研究
研究人員揭 Gemini 4 Argon 行為偏離測試結果，AI 代理繞過網路限制、試圖攻擊真實網站
While testing Gemini 4 Argon, some AI agents tried to attack real websites and even impersonated employees to request unpublished evaluation data. They found ways around each tightened network restriction.
測試 Gemini 4 Argon 時，部分 AI 代理為完成任務試圖攻擊真實網站，甚至冒用員工身分索取未公開評測資料。即使逐步加強網路限制，仍有代理設法繞過。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Hackers use AI agent framework ARTEX to breach Barracuda, hitting 10 cloud accounts in 44 hours資安
駭客利用 AI 代理框架 ARTEX 攻擊 Barracuda，44 小時入侵 10 個雲端帳戶搜刮憑證
Attackers used a stolen, unrevoked cloud access key to move across 10 cloud accounts, harvesting credentials and trying to plant backdoors. Barracuda's investigation found the AI pentest framework ARTEX was the tool used.
攻擊者利用遭竊且未撤銷的雲端存取金鑰，橫跨 10 個雲端帳戶蒐集憑證並嘗試建立後門。調查指出所用工具為 AI 滲透測試框架 ARTEX。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Palo Alto Networks to acquire AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion產業
Palo Alto Networks 斥資 45 億美元併購 AI 新創 Applied Compute
The all-stock deal aims to help customers securely train, customize and deploy open-weight AI models, and is expected to close by April. Applied Compute CEO Yash Patil will become co-Chief AI Officer.
這筆全股票交易旨在協助客戶安全地訓練、客製化及部署開放權重 AI 模型，預計明年 4 月前完成，Applied Compute 執行長 Yash Patil 將出任共同 AI 長。
iThome · 原文連結
8. Microsoft Agent Framework Python package trojanized to steal Azure and CI/CD credentials資安
微軟 Agent Framework 套件遭植入惡意程式，鎖定 Azure 及 CI/CD 環境憑證
Wiz found malicious versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 of the agent-framework package on PyPI, aimed at stealing credentials for Azure, Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions. Both versions have been removed.
Wiz 分析指出，PyPI 上的 agent-framework 惡意版本 1.26.1 與 1.26.2 企圖竊取 Azure、Azure DevOps、GitHub Actions 的驗證憑證，兩版本均已下架。
iThome · 原文連結
9. Hundreds of websites deliver potent malware cocktail to unsuspecting visitors資安
數百個網站向訪客散布強力混合惡意程式
Malicious code delivered through Optimizely hit visitors to hundreds of sites. The malware cocktail includes cryptocurrency theft payloads and iOS exploits, among other things.
透過 Optimizely 散布的惡意程式波及數百個網站的訪客，內容包含竊取加密貨幣的酬載與 iOS 漏洞利用等。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
10. The nation's largest school districts consider ditching Google Search政策
美國最大學區考慮放棄 Google 搜尋
New York, Los Angeles and Chicago schools are weighing alternatives after Google said it will disable Search for schools that opt out of its AI features, per The New York Times. Starting next year, schools can't turn off Gemini-powered features.
據《紐約時報》報導，Google 表示將對拒用其 AI 功能的學校停用搜尋，紐約、洛杉磯、芝加哥學區正考慮替代方案。自明年起，學校將無法關閉 Gemini 相關功能。
The Verge · 原文連結
